subject: general
question:
From the given graph, find the difference in the number of laptops and mobiles sold in comparison to the number of other products sold by a shop dealing in electronic items in the month of March 2019.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f218d971b32923705f6f066ef20bdb23946271137c364e576d67532dcc768637.png]
solution:
**Calculation:**

Sum of the number of laptops and mobiles sold = 500 + 600 = 1100 

Sum of the number of Radio, Tvs and watches sold = 100 + 300 + 200 = 600 

⇒ The difference in the no of laptops and mobiles sold in comparison to the no of other products = 1100 - 600 = 500

**∴ The required result = 500**
